А҆́гница твоѧ̀ і҆н҃се а҆кѷлі́на, * зове́тъ ве́лїимъ гла́сомъ: * тебѐ женишѐ мо́й люблю̀, * и҆ тебѐ и҆́щꙋщи страда́льчествꙋю, * и҆ сраспина́юсѧ, и҆ спогреба́юсѧ креще́нїю твоемꙋ̀, * и҆ страждꙋ̀ тебѐ ра́ди, ꙗ҆́кѡ да ца́рствꙋю въ тебѣ̀, * и҆ ᲂу҆мира́ю за тѧ̀, да и҆ живꙋ̀ съ тобо́ю: но ꙗ҆́кѡ же́ртвꙋ непоро́чнꙋю прїимѝ мѧ̀, съ любо́вїю поже́ршꙋюсѧ тебѣ̀. тоѧ̀ мл҃твами, ꙗ҆́кѡ млⷭ҇тивъ, сп҃сѝ дꙋ́шы на́шѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion, Tone 4:* Thy lamb Aquilina, O Jesus, * cries with a great voice: * Thee, my Bridegroom, do I love, * and seeking Thee I endure suffering, * and am crucified and buried with Thee in Thy baptism,[^379] * and suffer for Thy sake, that I may reign in Thee, * and die for Thee, that I may also live with Thee; * but receive me as a spotless sacrifice, * offered with love unto Thee! * By her supplications, * as Thou art merciful, save our souls!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Other Stichera [for St. Triphyllius], Tone 8:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тропа́рь ст҃и́телю, гла́съ то́йже: Пра́вило вѣ́ры, и҆ ѻ҆́бразъ кро́тости, воздержа́нїа ᲂу҆чи́телѧ, ꙗ҆вѝ тѧ̀ ста́дꙋ твое́мꙋ, ꙗ҆́же веще́й и҆́стина. сегѡ̀ ра́ди стѧжа́лъ є҆сѝ смире́нїемъ высо́каѧ, нището́ю бога̑таѧ, ѻ҆́ч҃е трїфѵ́ллїе, молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀, бг҃а спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion to the Hierarch, the same Tone:* The truth of things revealed thee unto thy flock as a rule of faith, an icon of meekness, and a teacher of abstinence; therefore thou didst acquire high things through humility, and rich things through poverty, O Father Triphyllius; pray thou unto Christ God that our souls may be saved!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Препросла́влена хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ жени́хꙋ твое́мꙋ, на нб҃сѣ́хъ вои́стиннꙋ ра́дꙋющисѧ предстои́ши. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ на землѝ бл҃гоче́стнѡ сла́вѧщыѧ, мл҃твами твои́ми воспросла́ви чтна́ѧ, и҆ себѣ̀ прича́стники сотворѝ, гдⷭ҇ви пою́щыѧ: сла́внѡ бо просла́висѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Most gloriously standing before Christ thy Bridegroom in the heavens, truly rejoicing; therefore, O honorable one, by thy prayers glorify them that piously glorify thee on earth, and make them communicants of thyself, who sing unto the Lord: For He is gloriously glorified!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ тѧ̀ все́льшаѧсѧ бл҃года́ть дх҃а, твою̀ дꙋ́шꙋ чи́стꙋ сла́внаѧ совершѝ, и҆ ра́нами тѣ́ла, краснѣ́йши была̀ є҆сѝ. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ жени́хъ дꙋ́шъ, чи́стꙋ до конца̀ нетлѣ́ннꙋ сꙋ́щꙋ, себѣ̀ ѡ҆брꙋчѝ прехва́льнаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The grace of the Spirit that dwelt within thee made thy soul pure, O glorious one; and by the wounds of thy body thou becamest fairer; therefore the Bridegroom of souls betrothed thee unto Himself, O all-lauded one, as being pure and incorrupt unto the end!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Tone 8. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Зимѣ̀ лю́тѣй земны̑ѧ концы̑ и҆спо́лншей дре́вле лю́тѣ, и҆спо́лнена сꙋ́щи дх҃а, ꙗ҆́кѡ мч҃ница неле́стнаѧ гдⷭ҇а вседержи́телѧ, дости́гла є҆сѝ веснꙋ̀ жи́зненнꙋю, и҆ побѣ́дꙋ взѧла̀ є҆сѝ побѣди́тельною а҆кѷлі́но сла́внаѧ, бг҃омꙋ́драѧ, досточꙋ́днаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* When a fierce winter filled the ends of the earth of old, being filled with the Spirit as a true martyr of the Lord Almighty, thou didst reach the life-giving spring, and didst win a victorious victory, O glorious, God-wise, and marvelous Aquilina!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆́же безнача́льномꙋ ѻ҆ц҃ꙋ̀ соприснꙋ́щный, вни́де во ᲂу҆тро́бꙋ твою̀, чл҃вѣ́къ бы́въ, и҆ спасѐ ны̀ ѕло́бою прекло́ншыѧсѧ, и҆ ле́стїю врага̀ порабоще́нныѧ, мр҃і́е бг҃оневѣ́сто. сегѡ̀ ра́ди вѣ́рою тѧ̀ и҆ любо́вїю ᲂу҆блажа́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* He Who is co-eternal with the unoriginate Father entered into thy womb, having become man, and saved us who were bowed down by malice and enslaved by the deceit of the enemy, O Mary, Bride of God; therefore do we call thee blessed with faith and love!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Canon, of the Holy Hierarch Triphyllius.* *Tone 2. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Хвалꙋ̀ бг҃ꙋ, вѣ́рою принесе́мъ всѝ, своего̀ ᲂу҆го́дника ᲂу҆кра́сив ᲂу҆краси́вшемꙋ, добродѣ́телми многообра́зными, и҆ втора́го мѡѷсе́а воздви́гшемꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* With faith let us all offer praise unto God, Who adorned His well-pleaser with manifold virtues and raised him up as a second Moses![^382]

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ты́ возше́дъ на го́рꙋ добродѣ́телей, бж҃твенный зако́нъ прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, ѻ҆́ч҃е трїфѵ́ллїе, и҆ скрижа́лїю по́мысла, добро́тꙋ дꙋшѝ твоеѧ̀ ᲂу҆ѧсни́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Ascending the mountain of virtues, thou didst receive the divine Law, O Father Triphyllius; and by the tablet of thy mind thou didst clarify the beauty of thy soul!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ты́ разꙋ́мнѡ прпⷣбне бл҃гоꙋха́ѧ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ: дꙋше́вное бо и҆сцѣле́нїе всѣ́мъ прозѧ́блъ є҆сѝ, ꙗ҆́коже тѣле́снымъ ѻ҆́ч҃е, бг҃одохнове́нно бы́лїе ꙗ҆́вльсѧ вѣ̑рнымъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst manifestly appear fragrant with understanding, O venerable one; for thou didst sprout spiritual healing for all as a bodily medicine, O Father, having appeared as a God-inspired herb unto the faithful!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Жи́зни и҆сто́чникъ была̀ є҆сѝ дв҃о чⷭ҇таѧ мт҃и, нача́лника и҆ гдⷭ҇а ро́ждши, жи́знь всѧ́ческихъ, ѡ҆проша́ющи вѣ́рою славосло́вѧщихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thou wast the wellspring of life, O pure Virgin Mother, having given birth unto the Prince and Lord, the Life of all, who intercedest for them that glorify thee with faith!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, г҃. І҆рмо́съ: Ты́ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆твержде́нїе притека́ющихъ къ тебѣ̀ гдⷭ҇и, ты́ є҆сѝ свѣ́тъ ѡ҆мраче́нныхъ, и҆ пое́тъ тѧ̀ дх҃ъ мо́й.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* *Thou art the establishment of them that flee unto Thee, O Lord; Thou art the light of the darkened, and my spirit hymns Thee![^383]*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆стла́ла є҆сѝ ри́зꙋ свѣ́та бл҃года́тїю сла́внаѧ, кро́вїю твое́ю а҆кѷлі́но мч҃нце, сщ҃е́ннѡ ѡ҆багри́вши.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆ѧзви́ласѧ є҆сѝ любо́вїю бж҃твенною ꙗ҆́вѣ всечтна́ѧ: тѣ́мже тве́рдѡ, ꙗ҆́звы же и҆ болѣ̑зни лю̑тыѧ претерпѣ́ла є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou wast manifestly wounded with divine love, O all-honorable one; therefore thou didst steadfastly endure wounds and fierce pains!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сїю̀ тѧ̀ ѡ҆свѧтѝ и҆зба́витель чⷭ҇тна́ѧ гдⷭ҇ь, все́ю крѣ́постїю сегѡ̀ а҆кѷлі́но, ѿ дꙋшѝ возлю́бльшꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The Savior and honorable Lord consecrated thee, O honorable Aquilina, who lovedst Him with all thy strength from thy soul!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Невѣ́стꙋ тѧ̀ безневѣ́стнꙋ, и҆ чи́сто чⷭ҇таѧ селе́нїе і҆н҃сово, ст҃ѣ́йшꙋ херꙋвї̑мъ вѣ́мы.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thee, an unwedded bride, and pure, clean dwelling-place of Jesus, we know to be holier than the cherubim!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Возсїѧ̀ свѣ́тлѡ ꙗ҆́коже сл҃нце мі́рꙋ, па́мѧть твоѧ̀ ст҃а́ѧ: и҆ просвѣща́етъ сердца̀ на́ша, вѣ́рнѡ соверша́ющихъ сїю̀ бл҃года́тїю.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thy holy memory has shone forth brightly upon the world like the sun; and it enlightens the hearts of us who faithfully celebrate it by grace!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Гро́здъ бы́въ бж҃твеннагѡ дх҃а, гро́здъ бж҃твенный прозѧ́бшій, и҆ вѣ́ры вїно̀ на́мъ вѣ̑рнымъ, мы́сленнѡ раствори́лъ є҆сѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having become a cluster of the Divine Spirit, which sprouted a divine cluster, thou didst noetically mix the wine of faith for us faithful!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ, ст҃и́телѧ, гла́съ, и҃. Подо́бенъ: Въ зра́ннои: И҆зрѧ́дствомъ житїѧ̀ чⷭ҇тотꙋ̀ дѣ́вства прїе́мъ трїфѵ́ллїе, первопресто́лникъ показа́лсѧ є҆сѝ леѵкꙋсі́и: и҆ ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ тѣ́мъ провозвѣсти́тель, и҆ бг҃оразꙋ́мїа наста́вникъ. сегѡ̀ ра́ди ра́достнѡ ра́достнѡ взыва́емъ тѝ: ра́дꙋйсѧ ст҃и́телей ᲂу҆краше́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having received the purity of virginity through excellence of life, O Triphyllius, thou wast shown forth as the primate of Leucosia; and thou wast revealed unto them as a herald and teacher of the knowledge of God; therefore joyfully joyfully do we cry unto thee: Rejoice, adornment of hierarchs!

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.section: Sessional Hymn of the Saint [Aquilina], Tone 8:* *Podoben: "Of Wisdom" (Премꙋ́дрости)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѣда́ленъ ст҃ы́ѧ, гла́съ, и҃. Подо́бенъ: Премꙋ́дрости: Добродѣ́телей ѡ҆сїѧ́вшисѧ бж҃твеннымъ свѣ́томъ, страда́льческимъ ᲂу҆краси́ласѧ є҆сѝ, пресла́внаѧ чⷭ҇тнаѧ вѣнце́мъ, и҆ красна̀ добро́тами бы́вши, вѣ́рою всѣ́хъ влⷣцѣ ᲂу҆невѣ́стиласѧ є҆сѝ вои́стиннꙋ, нескве́рнаѧ нетлѣ́ннаѧ. тѣ́мже нбⷭ҇нымъ сподо́биласѧ є҆сѝ черто́гѡмъ, до́брѣ пострада́вши, и҆ льсти́ваго побѣди́вши, а҆кѷлі́но бг҃омꙋ́драѧ: молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, согрѣше́нїй ѡ҆ставле́нїе дарова́ти, чтꙋ́щымъ любо́вїю ст҃ꙋю па́мѧть твою̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Illumined with the divine light of virtues, Thou didst adorn thyself with a martyr's crown, O glorious and honorable one; and having become fair in beauty, by faith Thou wast truly betrothed unto the Master of all, O undefiled and incorrupt one; therefore Thou wast accounted worthy of the heavenly bridal chambers, having suffered well and conquered the beguiler, O God-wise Aquilina: pray Thou unto Christ God to grant remission of sins unto them that honor thy holy memory with love!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ре́вность вѣ́ры и҆мѣ́ѧ преблаже́нне, прозѧ́блъ є҆сѝ плоды̀ зрѣ̑лы: врагѡ́въ бо посрами́лъ є҆сѝ полкѝ, и҆ дїа́вола трїфѵ́ллїе ᲂу҆би́лъ є҆сѝ. ѻ҆́че преподо́бне, хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а молѝ, дарова́ти на́мъ ве́лїю ми́лость.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having the zeal of faith, O all-blessed one, thou didst bud forth ripe fruits; for thou didst put to shame the legions of enemies, and slewest the devil, O Triphyllius, our venerable Father: pray thou unto Christ God to grant us great mercy!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бж҃твеннаѧ скині́а была̀ є҆сѝ сло́ва, є҆ди́на пречи́стаѧ мт҃и дв҃о, чистото́ю а҆́гг҃лы превозше́дшаѧ. па́че всѣ́хъ менѐ пе́рсть бы́вша, ѡ҆скверне́на плотски́ми прегрѣше́ньми, ѡ҆чи́сти мл҃твъ твои́хъ бж҃твенными вода́ми, подаю́щи чи́стаѧ ве́лїю мл҃ть.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou wast the divine tabernacle of the Word, O only all-pure Virgin Mother, who in purity surpassed the angels; cleanse me, who above all have become dust and am defiled with carnal transgressions, with the divine waters of thy prayers, granting, O pure one, great mercy!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: Нескве́рнаѧ а҆́гница сло́ва, нетлѣ́ннаѧ дв҃а мт҃и, на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ зрѧ́щи повѣ́шена, и҆з̾ неѧ̀ без̾ болѣ́зни прозѧ́бшаго, мт҃рски подо́бнѡ рыда́ющи, вопїѧ́ше: ᲂу҆вы̀ мнѣ̀ ча́до моѐ, ка́кѡ стра́ждеши во́лею, хотѧ̀ и҆зба́вити ѿ страсте́й безче́стїа человѣ́ка?
items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion:* The undefiled ewe-lamb of the Word, the incorrupt Virgin Mother, beholding Him Who sprouted from her without pain hanging upon the Cross, wailing maternally as was fitting, cried out: Woe is me, my Child! How dost Thou suffer willingly, desiring to deliver man from the passions of dishonor?

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Го́рдаго ѕмі́а ты́ не́мощїю тѣ́ла низложи́ла є҆сѝ, воева́вши свѣ́тлѡ, и҆ томи́телей на́глость потреби́вши.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst cast down the proud serpent by the weakness of thy body, having valiantly waged war, and didst destroy the insolence of the tormentors!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋче́нїа свѣ́тлостїю, и҆ дѣ́вства бж҃твенными добро́тами, а҆кѷлі́но была̀ є҆сѝ, влⷣцѣ невѣ́ста и҆зрѧ́днаѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* By the brightness of martyrdom and the divine beauty of virginity, O Aquilina, thou becamest an excellent bride unto the Master!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sessional Hymn of the Saint [Aquilina], Tone 8:* *Podoben: "Of Wisdom" (Премꙋ́дрости):*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тече́нїа крове́й твои́хъ многобо́жїа ѻ҆́гнь погаси́ша, чꙋде́съ же стрꙋѝ человѣ́кѡвъ ѡ҆мыва́ютъ недꙋ́ги.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The streams of thy blood quenched the fire of polytheism, and the currents of thy miracles wash away the infirmities of men!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Дрема́нїемъ ᲂу҆ны́нїа мѧ̀, со́нъ грѣхо́вный ѻ҆трокови́це пости́же, бо́дренною моли́твою твое́ю, возста́ви мѧ̀ къ покаѧ́нїю.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* The slumber of despondency and the sleep of sin have overtaken me, O Maiden; by thy vigilant prayer, raise me up unto repentance!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Triphyllius]:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сосꙋ́дъ вои́стиннꙋ пречи́стъ, показа́лсѧ є҆сѝ пребл҃же́нне ст҃и́телю, и҆ бж҃твенный дх҃ъ въ тѧ̀ всели́сѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou wast shown forth as a truly all-pure vessel, O all-blessed hierarch, and the Divine Spirit dwelt within thee!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Triphyllius]:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Просвѣ́щсѧ бж҃е́ственнымъ дх҃омъ, ᲂу҆́мъ преста́вилъ є҆сѝ къ вы́шнимъ, и҆ на пре́лесть ѻ҆́ч҃е подви́гналсѧ є҆сѝ крѣ́пкѡ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Enlightened by the Divine Spirit, thou didst transfer thy mind unto things on high, and strongly didst thou rise up against deceit, O Father!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́коже а҆́гнцы ᲂу҆па́слъ є҆сѝ, слове́сныѧ твоѧ̑ ѻ҆́вцы пребл҃же́нне, и҆ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ приве́лъ є҆сѝ словесы̀ твои́ми.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Like lambs thou didst shepherd thy noetic sheep, O all-blessed one, and didst bring them unto Christ by thy words!

items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thee as an invincible wall and a mighty hope, O Mother of God, have we faithful acquired in afflictions ever!

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Волнꙋ́емѣй ꙗ҆́коже свирѣ́пѣющїмсѧ мо́рю, ле́сти и҆ногда̀, ꙗ҆ви́ласѧ є҆сѝ ѡ҆кормлѧ́ема, а҆кѷлі́но мч҃ннце хрⷭ҇то́вою бл҃года́тїю.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* When deceit formerly raged like a surging sea, thou wast shown forth being steered, O Martyr Aquilina, by the grace of Christ!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Смотрѧ́ющи мч҃нице къ вѣнце́мъ, подала̀ є҆сѝ тве́рдѡ растерза́нїа ᲂу҆́дѡвъ твои́хъ, и҆ нꙋ́жднꙋю сме́рть.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Looking unto the crowns, O martyr, thou didst steadfastly surrender the tearing of thy limbs and a violent death!

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣтоѧвле́ннѡ ᲂу҆краси́ласѧ є҆сѝ, сопоста́ты са́мыѧ ᲂу҆ди́вльши, кра́сною твое́ю добро́тою, и҆ дꙋше́внымъ воста́нїемъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst adorn thyself with radiance, amazing the adversaries themselves with thy fair beauty and spiritual rising!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: И҆збавле́ннїи всѝ прароди́телнагѡ ѡ҆сꙋжде́нїа ржⷭ҇твомъ твои́мъ, ра́дꙋйсѧ тебѣ̀ приглаша́емъ, ѡ҆бра́дованнаѧ препѣ́таѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* All we who have been delivered from the ancestral condemnation by thy childbearing, cry unto thee: Rejoice, O full of grace, all-hymned one!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Triphyllius]:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бж҃твенною бл҃года́тїю преѡдѣ́ѧлсѧ держа́внѡ сла́вне, врага̀ низложи́лъ є҆сѝ си́лꙋ. и҆ вѣне́цъ ѿ бг҃а прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ досто́йнѡ, ꙗ҆́кѡ таи́нникъ трїфѵ́ллїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Mightily robed in divine grace, O glorious one, thou didst cast down the power of the enemy; and thou didst worthily receive a crown from God, as an initiate of the mysteries, O Triphyllius!

items.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF JUNE :: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Triphyllius]:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: На нб҃о возве́дъ дꙋшѝ твоеѧ̀ ѻ҆́чи сла́вне, бж҃е́ственныхъ позна́лъ є҆сѝ ᲂу҆че́нїй бе́зднꙋ ѻ҆́ч҃е, человѣ́кѡмъ ѿкрыва́ѧ трⷪ҇ческое сїѧ́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having lifted up the eyes of thy soul unto heaven, O glorious one, thou didst come to know the abyss of divine teachings, O Father, revealing the Trinitarian radiance unto men!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Triphyllius]:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Все ѻ҆рꙋ́жїе взе́мъ сщ҃енноѧвле́нне бж҃їе, посрами́лъ є҆сѝ собо́рнѡ вра́жїе мꙋ́жество. и҆ ᲂу҆че́нїи бж҃твенными главы̑ сокрꙋши́въ, вѣ́чнѡ ра́дꙋешисѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having taken up the whole armor of God, O sacredly revealed one, Thou didst openly put to shame the hostile might; and having shattered their heads by divine teachings, Thou rejoicest ever!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Воплоще́на и҆з̾ тебѐ бг҃ороди́телнице вѣ́рнїи позна́хомъ, без̾ сѣ́мене сн҃а рожде́на, бг҃а и҆́стинна, и҆ человѣ́ка є҆стество́мъ. тѣ́мже тѧ̀ сла́вимъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* We faithful have known the Son, born of thee without seed, to be incarnate from thee, O Mother of God: true God and man by nature; therefore do we glorify thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́съ: І҆ѡ́нꙋ въ ки́тѣ гдⷭ҇и, є҆ди́наго всели́лъ є҆сѝ, мене́ же свѧ́заннаго мре́жами вра́жїими, ꙗ҆́кѡ ѿ тлѝ ѻ҆́наго, спасѝ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Послѣ́довати хрⷭ҇товы̑мъ сла́внымъ вожделѣ́ла є҆сѝ страда́нїемъ д҃во, и҆ мꙋжемꙋ́дреннѡ претерпѣ́ла є҆сѝ сѣче́нїа, и҆ расторга́нїа ст҃а́гѡ твоегѡ̀ тѣлесѐ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst desire to follow Christ's glorious sufferings, O virgin, and didst courageously endure the lacerations and the tearing apart of thy holy body.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Многови́дныѧ болѣ́зни претерпѣ́ла є҆сѝ, ѻ҆гнѧ́ же небрегла̀ є҆сѝ болѣ́зни. тѣ́мже а҆кѵлі́но и҆ болѣ́зни на́ша всѧ̑ ѡ҆легча́еши, мл҃твами твои́ми.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst endure manifold pains, and didst make light of the pain of fire; therefore, O Aquilina, thou dost also lighten all our pains by thy prayers.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Смотрѧ́ѧ свы́ше, чꙋдѧ́шесѧ ли́къ а҆́ггльскїй сла́внаѧ д҃во, терпѣ́нїю твоемꙋ̀, ка́кѡ безпло́тныѧ врагѝ, съ пло́тїю побѣжда́ла є҆сѝ бл҃года́тїю.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́коже є҆нѡ́хъ преста́вилсѧ є҆сѝ дх҃омъ, ѿ земны́хъ ты̀ къ нбⷭ҇нымъ, и҆ нетлѣ́нїа прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, по достоѧ́нїю блаже́нне вѣне́цъ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Kontakion, Tone 2:* *Tone 2, Podoben: "Seeking the highest" (Вы́шнихъ и҆щѧ̀):*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.section: Kontakion, Tone 2:* *Tone 2, Podoben: "Seeking the highest" (Вы́шнихъ и҆щѧ̀)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ, гла́съ, в҃. Подо́бенъ: Вы́шнихъ и҆щѧ̀: Дѣ́вства твоегѡ̀ добро́тами, пред̾ѡчи́стивши дꙋ́шꙋ твою̀, и҆ на высотꙋ̀ мч҃енїемъ востекла̀ є҆сѝ а҆кѵлі́но всечтна́ѧ, любо́вїю жениха̀ твоегѡ̀ хрⷭ҇та̀ ᲂу҆ѧ́звльшисѧ, є҆мꙋ́же со а҆́гглы предстои́ши весе́лѧщисѧ: съ ни́миже не преста́й молѧ́сѧ ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ на́съ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having pre-cleansed thy soul with the beauties of thy virginity, thou didst ascend unto the heights by martyrdom, O all-honored Aquilina, wounded with love for Christ thy Bridegroom, before Whom thou standest rejoicing with the angels; with them cease not to pray for us all.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тѣлесѝ страда́ющꙋ бг҃омꙋ́драѧ неради́ла є҆сѝ, смотрѧ́ющи сꙋ́щаѧ та́мѡ воздаѧ́нїа, и҆ свѣ́тъ и҆ сла́вꙋ а҆кѵлі́но, и҆ бж҃їю красотꙋ̀, и҆ бж҃е́ственное весе́лїе.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѻ҆́бразꙋ страсте́й, воздержа́нїемъ разꙋ́мнѡ не поклони́лсѧ є҆сѝ, и҆ не ѡ҆палѝ тѣле́снаѧ пе́щь ѻ҆́ч҃е ро́гꙋ твою̀. дх҃а же и҆спо́лнивсѧ ст҃а́гѡ, дер́зостнѣ взыва́лъ є҆сѝ: бл҃гве́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆тє́цъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst not wisely bow down before the image of passions by self-control, and the bodily furnace did not scorch thy dew, O Father; and being filled with the Holy Spirit, thou didst boldly cry: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Triphyllius]:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Па́стырь перводѣ́теленъ показа́лсѧ є҆сѝ крѣ́покъ, леѵкѡ́ѵи мꙋ́дре, и҆ приве́лъ є҆сѝ влⷣцѣ твоемꙋ̀, мно́жество люде́й всепло́дїе. тѣ́мже вѣ́рнѡ про́симъ: предстоѧ̀ моли́сѧ ѡ҆ ста́дѣ твое́мъ бг҃ꙋ, и҆зба́витисѧ всѧ́кїѧ тлѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* A steadfast shepherd of prime virtue wast thou shown forth, O wise one of Leukosia, and thou didst bring unto thy Master a multitude of people as a whole-fruit offering; therefore do we faithfully entreat thee: standing before God, pray for thy flock, that it may be delivered from all corruption.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Живы́й и҆сто́чникъ сле́зъ твои́хъ мꙋ́дре и҆ пресла́вне, всѣ́хъ ᲂу҆дивля́етъ, и҆сцѣле́нїй бо стрꙋѧ́ми, при́снѡ бога́тѧщеся трїфѵ́ллїе. и҆ твои́хъ мо́щїй бл҃года́ть пое́мъ и҆ глаго́лемъ: бл҃гослове́нъ є҆сѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆́ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The living spring of thy tears, O wise and most glorious one, amazes all, for enriched ever with streams of healings, O Triphyllius, we sing the grace of thy relics and say: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃ородиченъ: Приста́нище тве́рдо, предста́тельнице стра́шнаѧ, и҆ стѣна̀ неѡбори́маѧ, въ нꙋ́ждахъ бѣ́дствꙋющымъ, ѡ҆ѕло́блємымъ въ ско́рбехъ, ꙗ҆́же къ сн҃ꙋ твоемꙋ̀ мольбы̀ бцⷣе и҆мꙋ́щи, ѿ многоѡбра́зныхъ и҆скꙋше́нїй, спаса́й рабы̑ твоѧ̑.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* O steadfast haven, dread intercessor, and invincible wall unto them that are in distress amid necessities and afflicted in tribulations: having entreaties unto thy Son, O Mother of God, save thy servants from manifold temptations!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Чи́ста же́ртва принесла́сѧ є҆сѝ, и҆ приноше́нїе пресвѣ́тло, и҆ ꙗ҆́кѡ бл҃гово́нный ѳѷмїа́мъ, а҆кѵлі́но бг҃омꙋ́драѧ, хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ бг҃ꙋ на́шемꙋ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou wast offered as a pure sacrifice and a most radiant offering, and as fragrant incense, O God-wise Aquilina, unto Christ our God.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Triphyllius]:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Недꙋ́ги разли́чныѧ чл҃вѣ́кѡмъ цѣли́тъ, и҆ ѿгонѧ́етъ де́монскїй вре́дъ, ст҃о́е тѣ́ло твоѐ а҆кѵлі́но, во гро́бѣ пресла́внаѧ лежа́щее.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thy holy body, lying in the tomb, O most glorious Aquilina, heals manifold diseases in men, and drives away demonic harm.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃ороди́ченъ: Нетлѣ́нное сло́во, па́че сло́ва тлѣ́нїѧ на́съ всѧ́кагѡ и҆зба́вльша родила̀ є҆сѝ. сегѡ̀ ра́ди тѧ̀ всѝ д҃во сла́вимъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Beyond speech thou didst give birth unto the incorruptible Word, Who delivered us from all corruption; therefore do all we glorify thee, O Virgin!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Triphyllius]:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Спасенїа пꙋ́ть, всѣ̑мъ ѿве́рзлъ є҆сѝ мꙋ́дре сꙋ́щымъ въ леѵкѡсі́и, пе́рвое сѣ́дъ на прⷭ҇то́лѣ цр҃ко́внемъ вѣ́рнѡ, ѿ бж҃е́ственнагѡ сїѧ́нїа сла́вне, сїѧ̀ ст҃и́телю прїи́мъ досто́йнѡ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst open the way of salvation unto all that were in Leukosia, O wise one, having first sat upon the ecclesiastical throne faithfully, receiving these things worthily from the divine radiance, O glorious hierarch.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Triphyllius]:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прибѣга́ющыѧ вѣ́рнѡ, къ ра́цѣ твое́й сщ҃енноѧвле́нне, ѿ бѣ́дъ и҆зба́вити и҆ и҆скꙋше́нїй врага̀, молѝ бл҃годѣ́телѧ хрⷭ҇та̀ неѡскꙋ́днѡ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Cease not to pray unto Christ the Benefactor to deliver from tribulations and temptations of the enemy them that faithfully flee unto thy shrine, O sacredly revealed one.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Triphyllius]:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆диви́шасѧ мꙋ́дре, а҆́гглстїи ли́цы твоемꙋ̀ поще́нїю, и҆ де́монскаѧ мно́жества тре́петъ прїѧ́ша вели́къ, и҆ всѧ́ко зда́нїе ᲂу҆жасе́сѧ. чл҃вѣ́ческїй ро́дъ почита́етъ тѧ̀ досто́йнѡ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The angelic choirs marveled at thy fasting, O wise one, and the demonic hordes took great trembling, and every creature was awestruck; the human race worthily honors thee.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Не забꙋ́ди гла́са предста́тельнице стра́шнаѧ, моли́твенникъ твои́хъ: но ѿ всѧ́кїѧ болѣ́зни мл҃твами твои́ми, и҆ бж҃їѧгѡ преще́нїѧ и҆схытѝ. преклони́тъ бо твоѐ ма́тернее бг҃а моле́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Forget not the voice of thy suppliants, O dread intercessor; but by thy prayers snatch us away from every disease and from the threatening of God; for thy maternal prayer inclines God!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Вои́стиннꙋ бцⷣꙋ тѧ̀ и҆сповѣ́дꙋемъ, спасе́нїи тобо́ю д҃во чи́стаѧ, съ безпло́тными ли́ки тѧ̀ велича́юще.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* *Truly do we confess thee to be the Mother of God, who have been saved through thee, O pure Virgin, magnifying thee with the bodiless choirs.[^397]*

items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having joined with the choirs of the bodiless and with the assemblies of martyrs, O all-praised one, pray unto God for us!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мы́сленное ѻ҆́ко на высотꙋ̀ взе́мъ, позна́лъ є҆сѝ трⷪ҇ческꙋю зарю̀, и҆ земна̑ѧ ѡ҆ста́вль мꙋ́дре, ѡ҆богати́лъ є҆сѝ всѣ́хъ бж҃твеннымъ просвѣще́нїемъ бголѣ́пнѡ. тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ по достоѧ́нїю въ пѣ́снехъ велича́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having lifted up the noetic eye unto the heights, thou didst come to know the Trinitarian dawn, and having forsaken earthly things, O wise one, thou didst divinely and richly endow all with divine enlightenment; therefore do we worthily magnify thee in hymns!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣти́лникъ показа́лсѧ є҆сѝ, всеблаже́нне мы́сленный леѵкꙋсі́емъ, ѡ҆бходѧ̀ ѡ҆кре́стныѧ страны̑ мꙋ́дре: и҆ хрⷭ҇товымъ позна́нїемъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ лꙋча́ми ѡ҆дꙋшевленными, ᲂу҆краси́въ сщ҃енными бголѣ́пнѡ, и҆ ле́сти мі́ра а҆́бїе и҆збавлѧ́ѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou wast shown forth as a noetic luminary unto Leukosia, O all-blessed one, traversing the surrounding regions, O wise one, and divinely adorning them with sacred knowledge of Christ as with animate rays, and immediately delivering them from the deceit of the world.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ны́нѣ вѣ́рнїи собрав́шесѧ, мо́лимъ тѧ̀ ѻ҆́ч҃е, при́снѡ моли́ти хрⷭ҇та̀: ꙗ҆́кѡ да гла́да, и҆ и҆ноплеме́нникѡвъ па́гꙋбы, и҆ всѧ́кїѧ бѣды̀, и҆зба́витъ на́съ ꙗ҆́кѡ си́ленъ. да тѧ̀ по достоѧ́нїю въ пѣ́снехъ велича́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* We faithful, having gathered together now, beseech thee, O Father, ever to pray unto Christ, that being mighty He may deliver us from famine, and from the destruction of foreigners, and from every misfortune; that we may worthily magnify thee in hymns!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃ородиченъ: Неска́заннагѡ чревоноше́нїа, неизрече́нное ржⷭ҇тво̀, ко́е сло́во ска́жетъ земноро́дныхъ? младе́нецъ бо бѣ̀ и҆ бг҃ъ рожде́йсѧ: ро́ждшаѧ же раба̀, и҆ м҃ти рожде́ннагѡ сн҃а бцⷣе. тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ пое́мъ, и҆ ржⷭ҇тво твоѐ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* What word of earthborn men can tell of thine ineffable childbearing, the inexpressible gestation? For He that was born was an Infant and God; and she that gave birth was a handmaid and the Mother of the born Son, O Mother of God; therefore do we hymn thee and thy childbearing!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Prophet, Tone 8:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Prophet, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ра́дꙋйсѧ є҆лїссе́е премꙋ́дре, * ты́ бо ѡ҆чи́стивъ ᲂу҆́мъ * ѿ сласте́й тѣле́сныхъ, прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ сла́вне зари̑ дх҃ѡ́вныѧ: * про́чымъ же всѣ̑мъ пре́далъ є҆сѝ, и҆ ве́сь ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ свѣтови́денъ. * Тѣ́мже всели́лсѧ є҆сѝ къ свѣ́тꙋ незаходи́момꙋ, * ѡ҆ на́съ всегда̀ молѧ́сѧ * восхваля́ющихъ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Rejoice, O most wise Elisha! For having purified thy mind from bodily pleasures, O glorious one, thou didst receive the spiritual rays, and didst transmit them unto all the rest, and wast shown forth wholly light-like; therefore hast thou settled unto the never-setting Light, ever praying for us that praise thee.

items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Prophet, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тѧ̀ є҆лїссе́е блаже́нне, * ревни́тель и҆лїа̀, * въ сꙋгꙋ́бѣй бл҃года́ти, * просвѣще́нна ѡ҆ста́вль, * воздꙋ́шный ѻ҆рꙋ́жникъ вои́стиннꙋ ꙗ҆вльші́йсѧ. * Є҆гѡ́же подо́бїемъ, бы́стрины рѣ́чныѧ ᲂу҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ бл҃года́тїю, * и҆ преше́лъ є҆сѝ сла́вне, ра́достнѡ ᲂу҆краша́ѧсѧ, и҆ велича́ѧ хрⷭ҇та̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: The zealous Elijah truly shown forth as a charioteer of the air, having left thee behind, O blessed Elisha, enlightened in a twofold portion of grace;[^399] through whose likeness thou didst stay the swift currents of the river by grace, and didst cross over, O glorious one, joyfully adorned and magnifying Christ!
items.slavonic_text: Тѧ̀ є҆лїссе́е блаже́нне, * ревни́тель и҆лїа̀, * въ сꙋгꙋ́бѣй бл҃года́ти, * просвѣще́нна ѡ҆ста́вль, * воздꙋ́шный ѻ҆рꙋ́жникъ вои́стиннꙋ ꙗ҆вльші́йсѧ. * Є҆гѡ́же подо́бїемъ, бы́стрины рѣ́чныѧ ᲂу҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ бл҃года́тїю, * и҆ преше́лъ є҆сѝ сла́вне, ра́достнѡ ᲂу҆краша́ѧсѧ, и҆ велича́ѧ хрⷭ҇та̀.
items.english_text: The zealous Elijah truly shown forth as a charioteer of the air, having left thee behind, O blessed Elisha, enlightened in a twofold portion of grace;[^399] through whose likeness thou didst stay the swift currents of the river by grace, and didst cross over, O glorious one, joyfully adorned and magnifying Christ!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Prophet, Tone 8:*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.section: At "Lord, I have cried," Stichera of the Prophet, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Дре́вле вѣ́ры сѡманїти́ды, * ѻ҆троча̀ да́рꙋетъ мл҃тва, * є҆го́же ᲂу҆ме́рша воздви́глъ є҆сѝ, * ꙗ҆́кѡ проро́къ бж҃твенный * сщ҃еннѡ ᲂу҆дивля́емь. * Со́лїю же па́ки во́ды безча́дныѧ, * ꙗ҆́вѣ претвори́лъ є҆сѝ въ чадоро́дїе, * чꙋдеса̀ безмѣ́рнаѧ соверша́еши, * бл҃гтїю вседѣ́телѧ дх҃а блаже́нне: * тѣ́мже пое́мъ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Of old, prayer bestowed the child of the Shunammite's faith,[^400] whom when he died thou didst raise up, sacredly marveled at as a divine prophet; and again by salt thou didst manifestly transform barren waters into childbearing,[^401] accomplishing measureless miracles by the grace of the all-creating Spirit, O blessed one; therefore do we hymn thee!

items.section: Other Stichera of St. Methodius, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѻ҆́ч҃е бг҃омꙋ́дре меѳо́дїе, * ꙗ҆́коже ле́въ рыка́нїемъ * премꙋ́дрыхъ ᲂу҆че́нїй твои́хъ, * гли́ннина ᲂу҆жа́силъ є҆сѝ льсти́ваго ли́са, * и҆ ᲂу҆́бѡ не терпѧ̀ * твоегѡ̀ ѡ҆бличе́нїа, * ра́збою меча̀ сѣка́етъ сїѧ̀ ѕлочести́вый. * Тѣ́мже не ѡ҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ ста́да гиб́лемагѡ хрⷭ҇това, * побо́рникъ бы́въ * правосла́внымъ лю́демъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O God-wise Father Methodius: like a lion by the roaring of thy most wise teachings, thou didst terrify the crafty earthen fox;[^402] and unable to endure thy rebuke, the impious one cut them with the robbery of the sword; yet thou didst not abandon the perishing flock of Christ, having become a champion for the Orthodox people.

items.section: Other Stichera of St. Methodius, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Правосла́вїа ᲂу҆твержде́нїе, * цр҃кве па́стырь, * мона́хѡвъ ᲂу҆добре́нїе, * рѣка̀ наводнѧ́ема вода́ми дх҃а, * ча́ша пролива́ющаѧ питїѐ пресла́дко, * свѣти́ло просвѣща́ющее мі́ра концы̑, * ѻ҆бою́дꙋ наѡщре́нъ бл҃года́тїю, * и҆ ѕлочести́выхъ полкѝ сѣкі́ющь, * ты́ є҆сѝ меѳо́дїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: The confirmation of Orthodoxy, the shepherd of the Church, the adornment of monastics, a river flooded with the waters of the Spirit, a chalice pouring forth a most sweet drink, a luminary enlightening the ends of the world, sharpened on both sides by grace and cutting down the hosts of the impious—this art thou, O Methodius!

items.section: Other Stichera of St. Methodius, Tone 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆сповѣ́данїа ѻ҆́бразъ, * ст҃ле́й ѡ҆снова́нїе, * и҆ бг҃одохнове́ненъ ѻ҆рга́нъ, * воспѣва́ѧ ᲂу҆че́нїа бл҃гоче́стїа и҆спо́лненъ, * премꙋ́дрости до́мъ, любвѐ пꙋчи́на, * милова́нїа стрꙋѧ̀ приснотекꙋ́щаѧ, * ѡ҆кри́нъ и҆злива́ющь пи́во ᲂу҆миле́нїа, * и҆ бл҃гоцвѣтꙋ́щь сла́вне ра́й, * ты́ є҆сѝ меѳо́дїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: An image of confession, a foundation of hierarchs, and a God-inspired instrument filled with singing the teachings of piety, a house of wisdom, an abyss of love, an ever-flowing stream of mercy, a vessel pouring forth the drink of compunction, and a flourishing paradise, O glorious one—this art thou, O Methodius!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прⷪ҇рѡ́къ бж҃твенное прише́ствїе возсїѧ̀ дне́сь, созыва́юще та́йнѡ празднолюбныѧ дꙋ́шы. и҆́же на колесни́цѣ нб҃оте́чнѣ всѣ́дъ, восто́ка небе́снагѡ ѕвѣзда̀, съ є҆лїссе́емъ чꙋ́днымъ мꙋ́жемъ, разширѧ́етъ стрꙋѝ но́вагѡ і҆орда́на, проповѣ́данїе ᲂу҆ѧснѧ́ѧ бл҃гоче́стїа, сꙋгꙋ́бымъ ѻ҆́бразомъ воѡбража́юще ꙗ҆́снѡ, ве́тхїѧ и҆ но́выѧ є҆диногла́сныѧ сла́вы, сꙋгꙋ́бо бл҃гве́нїе, во є҆́же вѣ́рнѡ соверша́ющихъ, всепра́зднственную па́мѧть и҆́хъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The divine coming of the prophets has shone forth today, mystically summoning the feast-loving souls: he who mounted the heaven-coursing chariot, the star of the heavenly Orient,[^403] together with Elisha the marvelous man, broadens the streams of the new Jordan, elucidating the preaching of piety, clearly depicting in twofold manner the unison glory of the Old and New, a twofold blessing unto them that faithfully celebrate their all-festal memory!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: Подо́бенъ: Є҆гда̀ ѿ дре́ва: Дре́вꙋ крⷭ҇тномꙋ тѧ̀ і҆и҃се пригвожде́на, зрѧ́щи неискꙋсобра́чнаѧ, пла́чꙋщи гла́ше: ча́до сла́дкое, почто̀ ѡ҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ менѐ ро́ждшꙋю тѧ̀ є҆ди́нꙋ, свѣ́те непристꙋ́пный пребезна́чалнагѡ ѻ҆ц҃а̀? потщи́сѧ и҆ просла́висѧ, ꙗ҆́кѡ да сла́вꙋ полꙋ́чатъ бж҃твеннꙋю, и҆́же бж҃е́ственныѧ ст҃рти твоѧ̑ сла́вѧщїи.
items.english_cohort_translation: Beholding Thee nailed unto the wood of the Cross, O Jesus, she that knew not wedlock weeping said: O sweet Child, why hast Thou left me alone who gave Thee birth, O unapproachable Light of the unoriginate Father? Hasten and be glorified, that they who glorify Thy divine sufferings may obtain divine glory!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Aposticha, of the feast or of the Octoechos.*
items.office: At Matins, after the 1st Kathisma, Sessional Hymn, Tone 8
items.section: At the Aposticha, of the feast or of the Octoechos.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Веселѡ̀ дне́сь цр҃ковь бж҃їа ѡ҆дѣва́етсѧ, и҆ ра́дꙋетсѧ зовꙋ́щи: ᲂу҆ѧсни́сѧ моѧ̀ добро́та, па́че всѧ́кагѡ гра́да: се́ бо ст҃и́телей вели́кое сокро́вище сла́вный меѳо́дїй, ше́ствїе къ нб҃семъ сотворѝ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Joyfully today the Church of God is robed and rejoices, crying: My beauty has been made clearer than that of every city, for lo! the glorious Methodius, the great treasure of hierarchs, has made his journey unto the heavens! Come then, ye feast-lovers, assembly of the Orthodox, forming a choir together around the divine shrine, receiving streams of healings from it, to entreat Christ God to deliver the universe from every heresy!

items.section: At the Aposticha, of the feast or of the Octoechos.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прⷪ҇ро́че проповѣ́дателю хв҃ъ, прⷭ҇то́ла вели́чества никогда́же ѿлꙋче́йисѧ, и҆ коемꙋ́ждо болѧ́щꙋ при́снѡ предстои́ши, въ вы́шнихъ слꙋжа̀, вселе́ннꙋю бл҃гословля́еши. всю́дꙋ прославля́емь просѝ, ѡ҆чище́нїа дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: O prophet, preacher of Christ, who wast never parted from the throne of majesty, and dost ever stand by each that is sick, serving in the highest, thou blessest the universe; being glorified everywhere, ask purification for our souls!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: Под: Трїдне́венъ: На дре́вѣ живо́тъ на́шъ, * зрѧ́щи всенепоро́чнаѧ бцⷣе ви́сѧщь, * мт҃рски рыда́ющи вопїѧ́ше: * сн҃е мо́й, и҆ бж҃е мо́й, * спасѝ любо́вїю пою́щыѧ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Beholding our Life hanging upon the wood, the all-immaculate Mother of God weeping maternally cried aloud: O my Son and my God, save them that sing unto Thee in love!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тропа́рь, проро́ка, гла́съ, д҃. Во пло́ти а҆́гглъ, прⷪ҇ро́кѡвъ ѡ҆снова́нїе, вторы́й предте́ча прише́ствїѧ хрⷭ҇то́ва и҆лїа̀ сла́вный, свы́ше посла́вый є҆лїссе́еви бл҃ть, недꙋ́ги ѿгона́ти, и҆ прокаже́нныѧ ѡ҆чища́ти: тѣ́мже и҆ почита́ющымъ є҆го̀ то́читъ и҆сцѣле́нїѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion of the Prophet, Tone 4:* The angel in the flesh, the foundation of the prophets, the second forerunner of the coming of Christ, glorious Elijah, sent down grace from on high unto Elisha to drive away diseases and cleanse lepers; therefore he also pours forth healings unto them that honor him.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пра́вило вѣ́ры, и҆ ѻ҆́бразъ кро́тости, воздержа́нїѧ ᲂу҆чи́телѧ, ꙗ҆вѝ тѧ̀ ста́дꙋ твоемꙋ̀, ꙗ҆́же веще́й и҆́стина. сегѡ̀ ра́ди стѧжа́лъ є҆сѝ смире́нїемъ высо́каѧ, нището́ю бога̑таѧ. ст҃лю меѳо́дїе, молѝ хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а, спасти́сѧ дꙋша́мъ на́шымъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: The truth of things revealed thee unto thy flock as a rule of faith, an icon of meekness, and a teacher of temperance; therefore hast thou achieved the heights through humility, and riches through poverty: O hierarch Methodius, entreat Christ God that our souls may be saved!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆з̾ нача́ла ѡ҆ бз҃ѣ поє́мыѧ пѣ́сни, и҆́миже пое́тсѧ пое́мый, проро́ческими ѡ҆блиста́ѧ хвала́ми, пою̀ просла́вльшаго, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Flashing forth with prophetic praises the hymns sung of old in God, whereby He that is praised is sung, I hymn Him that glorified him, for He has been glorified!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Взе́мъ ко́жꙋ и҆з̾ рꙋкѝ проро́чи, совоспрїѧ́тъ сн҃ъ, ѿ ра́ла проро́къ претворѧ́емь, заре́ю дх҃овною, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having taken the mantle from the prophet's hand,[^405] the son was received, being transformed from the plow into a prophet by the spiritual dawn; for He has been glorified!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́кѡ предразꙋ́мѣ хрⷭ҇тѐ, є҆́же кь лꙋ́чшемꙋ зва́нїе, є҆лїссе́ево предложе́нїе, прⷪ҇ро́чества бл҃года́тїю просвѣти́лъ є҆сѝ, сп҃се всеси́льне, ꙗ҆́кѡ просла́висѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* As Thou didst foreknow Elisha's purpose, O Christ, His calling unto that which is better, Thou didst enlighten him with the grace of prophecy, O all-powerful Savior; for He has been glorified!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Tone 5. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃ородиченъ: Пречⷭ҇таѧ м҃ти бж҃їа, воплоще́ннагѡ и҆з̾ тебѐ, и҆ ѿ нѣ́дръ роди́телѧ не ѿлꙋ́чшагосѧ бг҃а, непреста́ннѡ молѝ, ѿ всѧ́кїѧ бѣды̀ спастѝ ꙗ҆́же созда́лъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* O all-pure Mother of God, [entreat] God Who was incarnate from thee, and was not separated from the bosom of the Father [O all-pure Mother of God, entreat] God [Who was incarnate from thee, and was not separated from the bosom of the Father], unceasingly to save from every affliction those whom He created.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Canon of St. Methodius.* *Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Въ постѣ́хъ преподо́бне поражда́ѧ тѣ́ло твоѐ, ᲂу҆ма́стилъ є҆сѝ дꙋ́шꙋ твою̀, восхожде́нїи бж҃е́ственными, и҆ пи́щꙋ прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ вы́шнагѡ црⷭ҇тва, неизжива́емꙋю.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Subduing thy body in fasts, O venerable one, thou didst enrich thy soul with divine ascents, and didst receive the inexhaustible nourishment of the supreme Kingdom.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Canon of St. Methodius.* *Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Слове́снымъ мече́мъ воѡрꙋжи́всѧ дх҃а, ꙗ҆́коже во бронѧ̑ вѣ́рою ѡ҆дѣ́ѧвсѧ, и҆ мꙋ́жески є҆ретїкѡ́въ полкѝ пресѣка́лъ є҆сѝ, всеблаже́нне меѳо́дїе ѻ҆́ч҃е.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Armed with the spiritual sword of the Word, and clothed with faith as with a breastplate, thou didst courageously cut down the hosts of heretics, O all-blessed Father Methodius!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Canon of St. Methodius.* *Tone 4. Ode 1. Heirmos:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Рѣка̀ приснотекꙋ́щаѧ, цр҃кви бы́ша ᲂу҆ста̀ твоѧ̑ бж҃твеннаѧ, є҆ретї́ческаѧ морѧ̀ ꙗ҆́кѡ вои́стиннꙋ преподо́бне меѳо́дїе и҆зсꙋши́ла, и҆ напоѧ́ѧ вѣ́рныѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thy divine mouth was an ever-flowing river unto the Church, truly drying up the heretical seas, O venerable Methodius, and watering the faithful.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃ородиченъ: Сѣ́нь ѡ҆дꙋшевленнꙋ, и҆ ковче́гъ и҆ трапе́зꙋ, го́рꙋ ѿ неѧ́же ᲂу҆сѣче́сѧ без̾ рꙋ́къ человѣ́чъ ка́мень, и҆́же всѣ́хъ гдⷭ҇ь, мр҃і́ю пречⷭ҇тꙋю пѣ́снми почти́мъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Let us honor in hymns the animate tabernacle, the ark, the table, and the mountain from which the Stone was cut without hands of man, the Lord of all—all-pure Mary!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, г҃. І҆рмо́съ: Си́лою крⷭ҇та̀ твоегѡ̀ хрⷭ҇тѐ, ᲂу҆твердѝ моѐ помышле́нїе, во є҆́же пѣ́ти и҆ сла́вити спаси́тельное твоѐ вознесе́нїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 3. Heirmos:* *By the power of Thy Cross, O Christ, establish my mind, that I may hymn and glorify Thy saving Ascension![^407]*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тꙋчено́сный бы́сть ѻ҆́блакъ, ꙗ҆зы́къ тво́й меѳо́дїе: сердца̀ бо бл҃гочести́выхъ напая́ющь сло́вомъ, нечести́выхъ же всегда̀ подавля́ющь пле́велы.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thy tongue was a rain-bearing cloud, O Methodius; for watering the hearts of the pious with the word, it ever choked the tares of the impious.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Methodius]:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆справля́ѧ вѣ́ры сло́во, ранъ и҆́скꙋсъ прїѧ́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ въ мра́чнѣй ѻ҆́ч҃е темни́цѣ сѣдѣ́ти ѡ҆сꙋжде́нъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ. тѣ́мже къ свѣ́тꙋ невече́рнемꙋ, преста́вилсѧ є҆сѝ весе́лѧсѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Setting upright the word of faith, thou didst endure the trial of stripes, and wast condemned to sit in a dark prison, O Father; therefore hast thou passed over unto the never-waning Light, rejoicing!

items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Мꙋ́ченикѡвъ страда́нїа воспѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, си́хъ прича́стилсѧ є҆сѝ неѿе́млемыѧ ѻ҆́ч҃е ра́дости, ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋгꙋ́бѡ пострада́въ, непреста́нными скорбьмѝ, и҆ ра́нами меѳо́дїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst sing the sufferings of the martyrs, and didst partake of their inalienable joy, O Father, having suffered doubly with unceasing afflictions and wounds, O Methodius!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Kontakion of St. Methodius, Tone 2:* *Tone 2, Podoben: "The firm and God-proclaimed preachers" (Тве́рдыѧ):*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.section: Kontakion of St. Methodius, Tone 2:* *Tone 2, Podoben: "The firm and God-proclaimed preachers" (Тве́рдыѧ)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ, меѳо́дїа, гла́съ, в҃. Подо́бенъ: Тве́рдыѧ: На землѝ подвиза́лсѧ є҆сѝ ꙗ҆́кѡ безпло́тный, и҆ нб҃са̀ наслѣ́довалъ є҆сѝ меѳо́дїе: ꙗ҆́кѡ и҆з̾ѧсни́вый въ концѣ́хъ і҆кѡ́нъ поклоне́нїе, въ трꙋдѣ́хъ бо и҆ болѣ́знехъ вя́щше пребы́въ, не преста́лъ є҆сѝ дерзнове́нїемъ ѡ҆блича́ѧ ѿмета́ющыѧсѧ і҆кѡ́ны хрⷭ҇товы.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst contend on earth as one bodiless, and didst inherit the heavens, O Methodius, having elucidated the veneration of icons unto the ends of the earth; for having remained more abundantly in labors and afflictions, thou didst not cease boldly rebuking them that reject the icons of Christ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Kontakion of St. Methodius, Tone 2:* *Tone 2, Podoben: "The firm and God-proclaimed preachers" (Тве́рдыѧ):*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆́косъ: Грѣхѡ́въ мѝ разрѣше́нїе пода́ждь, є҆́же пѣ́ти по достоѧ́нїю по́двиги твоѧ̑, меѳо́дїе пресла́вне. въ ро́въ бо глубо́къ вве́рженъ бы́лъ є҆сѝ, даꙗ́же пре́жде дꙋ́шы во глубинѣ̀ погребе́нныѧ невѣ́дѣнїа, разрѣши́ши къ сїѧ́нїю бж҃твеннагѡ свѣтоли́тїа: навꙋчи́въ ꙗ҆́вѣ подсо́лнечнꙋю, бж҃е́ственному вои́стиннꙋ неизрече́нномꙋ хр҃то́вꙋ покланѧ́тисѧ воѡбраже́нїю, ѡ҆блича́ѧ ѿмета́ющыѧсѧ і҆кѡ́ны хрⷭ҇товы.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:* Grant me remission of sins, that I may worthily hymn thy struggles, O most glorious Methodius! For thou wast cast into a deep pit,[^410] so that thou mightest release souls previously buried in the depth of ignorance unto the radiance of divine light-shedding: having manifestly taught all under the sun to bow down unto the divine, truly ineffable representation of Christ, rebuking them that reject the icons of Christ.

For thou wast cast into a deep pit,[^410] so that thou mightest release souls previously buried in the depth of ignorance unto the radiance of divine light-shedding: having manifestly taught all under the sun to bow down unto the divine, truly ineffable representation of Christ, rebuking them that reject the icons of Christ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Methodius]:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ты̀ проповѣ́датель боже́ствененъ, сла́докъ сло́вомъ, про́стъ нра́вы, дх҃овными дарова́нїи ст҃лю прпⷣбне пребога́тъ, ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ меѳо́дїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* A divine preacher, sweet in word, simple in disposition, exceedingly rich in spiritual gifts, wast thou shown forth, O venerable hierarch Methodius!

items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Копїе́мъ мы́сленнымъ бж҃е́ственнагѡ сло́ва, є҆́же въ ме́рзости є҆ретї́честѣй, сꙋ́щꙋю пострѣка́въ ᲂу҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ нече́стїа на́глость меѳо́дїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having pierced with the noetic lance of the divine Word the insolence of impiety that was in heretical abomination, thou didst put an end to it, O Methodius!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Methodius]:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ра́дꙋйсѧ две́ре мы́сленнаѧ, и҆з̾ неѧ́же про́йде неизрече́ннымъ сло́вомъ цр҃ь нб҃ный, и҆ соблю́дъ непоро́чнꙋ, запеча́танꙋ па́ки ѡ҆ста́ви.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Rejoice, O noetic gate, through which by an ineffable word the King of Heaven passed, and keeping thee blameless, left thee sealed again!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, є҆́. І҆рмо́съ: Оу҆́тренююще вопїе́мъ тѝ гдⷭ҇и, спаси́ ны: ты́ бо є҆сѝ бг҃ъ на́шъ, ра́звѣ бо тебѐ и҆но́гѡ не зна́емъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆з̾ѡщре́на тро́сть дх҃а ꙗ҆зы́къ тво́й, ꙗ҆́кѡ скоропи́сца кни́жника меѳо́дїе показа́сѧ, на скрижа́ли начерта́ѧ се́рдцъ бл҃года́ти, бж҃твенный зако́нъ нело́жнѡ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆збавлѧ́еши мл҃твами твои́ми ѿ всѧ́кагѡ ѡ҆бстоѧ́нїа, прибѣга́ющымъ въ покро́въ тво́й мр҃і́е бцⷣе: ты́ бо чтꙋ́щихъ тѧ̀ предста́тельница є҆сѝ и҆ ᲂу҆пова́нїе съ бг҃омъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* By thy prayers thou deliverest from every adversity them that flee beneath thy protection, O Mary, Mother of God; for after God, thou art the intercessor and hope of them that honor thee!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѕ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Ѡ҆бы́де мѧ̀ бе́здна, гро́бъ мнѣ̀ ки́тъ бы́сть, а҆́зъ же возопи́хъ къ тебѣ̀ чл҃колю́бцꙋ, и҆ спасѐ мѧ̀ десни́ца твоѧ̀ гдⷭ҇и.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 6. Heirmos:* *The abyss surrounded me, the sea-monster became a tomb unto me; yet I cried unto Thee, the Lover of mankind, and Thy right hand saved me, O Lord![^416]*

items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆спо́лни пото́ки и҆ногда̀, ни до́ждь, ни дꙋ́хъ воздꙋ́шный, воздꙋ́хъ же бл҃года́ти проро́че, и҆ сло́во твоѐ, дѣ́йствомъ дх҃а напо́лни.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Of old it filled the torrent-valleys:[^417] neither rain nor wind of the air, but the breeze of grace, O prophet, and thy word by the operation of the Spirit filled them!

items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ма́ла сосꙋ́да и҆ногда̀ проро́че, ꙗ҆́коже напо́лнилъ є҆сѝ незави́стнѡ є҆ле́й женѣ̀, и҆ мнѣ̀ бж҃е́ственною ми́лость и҆сточи́ти є҆лїссе́е помоли́сѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* As of old, O prophet, thou didst lavishly fill the widow's small vessel with oil,[^418] so pray, O Elisha, that divine mercy may pour forth unto me!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Methodius]:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Честна́ѧ жена̀ проро́че, вѣ́рою вжила́ема, въ ста́рости непло́дствїа разрѣше́нїе прїе́млетъ моли́твою, бл҃гоча́дїе плодѧ́щи.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The honorable woman, sustained by faith, O prophet, received release from barrenness in old age through prayer, bearing fair offspring.[^419]

items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пчелѣ̀ трꙋдолюби́вѣй поревнова́въ, пи́сменныѧ собра́лъ є҆сѝ цвѣ́ты. ꙗ҆́коже въ сотѣ̀, се́рдцемъ твои́мъ сїѐ состро́илъ, и҆ всѣ̑мъ и҆сточа́ѧ рѣкꙋ̀ ᲂу҆че́нїй твои́хъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Emulating the industrious bee, thou didst gather the flowers of writings; and as in a honeycomb, thou didst construct this in thy heart, pouring forth unto all the river of thy teachings.

items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Слове́съ дх҃овныхъ напо́лнивсѧ ꙗ҆зы́къ тво́й премꙋ́дре, ꙗ҆зыкобѡ́лїа низложѝ хꙋ́лниковъ, проповѣ́дающь хрⷭ҇тово воплоще́нїе почита́ти, и҆ плотско́е подо́бїе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Being filled with spiritual words, O most wise one, thy tongue cast down the babbling of the blasphemers, preaching that the Incarnation of Christ and His likeness in the flesh are to be honored.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пе́рвѣе ᲂу҆́бѡ на сѣда́лищи ста́рецъ похвали́въ гдⷭ҇а, на ст҃и́тельстѣ прⷭ҇то́лѣ, напослѣ́докъ же вознесе́сѧ є҆сѝ са́мъ, ᲂу҆па́слъ бг҃оꙋго́днѡ и҆збра́нныѧ ѻ҆́ч҃е сїѧ̑ лю́ди.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* First indeed the elder upon the seat praised the Lord upon the hierarchal throne; and at last thou thyself didst ascend, having tended in a manner pleasing unto God these chosen people, O Father!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Є҆ди́нꙋ тѧ̀ бг҃а на́шегѡ мт҃рь бцⷣе влⷣчце, тва́рь всѧ̀ познава́етъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ є҆ди́на вмѣсти́ла є҆сѝ бг҃а неска́заннѡ во ᲂу҆тро́бѣ твое́й, бж҃е́ственнымъ не ѡ҆пали́вшисѧ ѻ҆гне́мъ.

items.section: Kontakion, Tone 2:* *Tone 2, Podoben: "Seeking the highest" (Вы́шнихъ и҆щѧ̀)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ, гла́съ, в҃. Подо́бенъ: Вы́шнихъ и҆щѧ̀: Проро́къ бж҃ій ꙗ҆ви́лсѧ є҆сѝ, сꙋгꙋ́бꙋю бл҃года́ть пріе́мъ, вои́стиннꙋ досто́йнꙋю тебѐ, Е҆ліссе́е бл҃же́нне: И҆ліѝ бо бы́лъ є҆сѝ собесѣ́дникъ, съ ни́мъ хрⷭ҇тꙋ̀ бг҃ꙋ молѧ́сѧ непреста́ннѡ ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ на́съ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou didst appear as a prophet of God, having received a double portion of grace, truly worthy of thee, O blessed Elisha; for thou wast a companion of Elijah, with him unceasingly praying unto Christ God for us all.

items.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF JUNE :: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Kontakion, Tone 2:* *Tone 2, Podoben: "Seeking the highest" (Вы́шнихъ и҆щѧ̀):*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: І҆́косъ: И҆́же въ зако́нѣ гдⷭ҇ни возсіѧ́вшаго, всѝ Е҆ліссе́а мꙋ́драго пѣ́ніи пѣ́сненными воспое́мъ: ве́сь бо и҆спо́лненъ є҆́сть чꙋде́съ, сꙋгꙋ́быми ѡ҆́бразы, на́мъ и҆сточа́ѧ и҆сцѣле́ній стрꙋѝ, кропи́тъ бо дꙋ́шы вѣ́рныхъ, и҆ спаса́етъ ѿ бѣ́дъ, ꙗ҆́коже дре́вле лю́ди безча́дствꙋющыѧ, ᲂу҆слажда́етъ со́лію во́ды, креще́ніѧ бл҃года́ть возвѣща́ѧ, молѧ̀ непреста́ннѡ ѡ҆ всѣ́хъ на́съ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ikos:* Let us all hymn with songs of praise the wise Elisha, who shone forth in the Law of the Lord; for he is full of miracles in twofold images, pouring forth streams of healings unto us: for he sprinkles the souls of the faithful, and saves from misfortunes, even as of old for the childless people he sweetened the waters with salt, proclaiming the grace of baptism,[^421] praying unceasingly for us all.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Methodius]:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Росо́ю бж҃твенныѧ любвѐ, погаси́лъ є҆сѝ страсте́й пресла́вне разжже́ннꙋю пе́щь, ꙗ҆ви́всѧ же ꙗ҆́кѡ зла́то напа́стми горни́ломъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ со́лнце блиста́еши.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* With the dew of divine love, O most glorious one, thou didst extinguish the ignited furnace of passions; and having been shown forth through trials as gold in a crucible, thou shinest like the sun.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Methodius]:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: А҆дама́нтское се́рдце въ ско́рбехъ и҆мѣ́лъ є҆сѝ, и҆ въ гоне́ніихъ Меѳо́діе, и҆ нн҃ѣ блиста́еши лꙋча́ми нбⷭ҇ными, и҆ ѻ҆гнедохнове́нными ᲂу҆сты̀: тѣ́мже тѧ̀ восхва́лѧемъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst possess an adamantine heart in afflictions and in persecutions, O Methodius, and now thou shinest with heavenly rays and with fire-breathing lips; therefore do we praise thee.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ꙗ҆́коже неѡбори́мь сто́лпъ, неподви́жнымъ пребы́лъ є҆сѝ напа́стными прило́ги, пре́лести ᲂу҆твержде́ніе низлага́ѧ ст҃и́телю, си́лою твои́хъ слове́съ, Меѳо́діе пребл҃же́нне.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆тъ ве́щи ѡ҆чи́щь ᲂу҆́мъ, невеще́ственнѡ невеще́ственнагѡ, жела́ніемъ ѡ҆держи́мь, ви́дѣлъ є҆сѝ. Тѣ́мже и҆гра́ѧ вопіѧ́лъ є҆сѝ: хрⷭ҇та̀ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having cleansed thy mind from matter, possessed by desire, thou didst immaterially behold the Immaterial One. Therefore, leaping for joy, thou didst cry: Supremely exalt Christ unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бл҃года́тію прови́дѧ бꙋ́дꙋщаѧ, на дре́вѣ прⷱ҇чты́й крⷭ҇тъ зри́ши воѡбраже́нъ. Тѣ́мже вопіѧ́лъ є҆сѝ ра́дꙋѧсѧ, бг҃онаꙋче́нный прⷪ҇ро́че: хрⷭ҇та̀ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Foreseeing the future by grace, thou seest the most pure Cross prefigured on the wood;[^427] therefore, rejoicing, thou didst cry, O God-taught prophet: Supremely exalt Christ unto all ages!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Methodius]:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Колесни́цъ мно́жество ѡ҆крⷭ҇тъ ви́дѣвъ, низложѝ чꙋ́дне, мра́комъ незави́стнѡ ᲂу҆ста́вилъ є҆сѝ, безꙋ́міе ѡ҆блича́ѧ всебл҃же́нне, вопіѧ̀: хрⷭ҇та̀ превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Having seen a multitude of chariots round about, O marvelous one, thou didst cast down [the foes]; with darkness thou didst unstintingly strike them, rebuking their folly, O all-blessed one,[^428] crying: Supremely exalt Christ unto all ages!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: А҆́гг҃ли сла́вѧтъ рождество̀ твоѐ, чⷭ҇таѧ бг҃оневѣ́сто. Съ ни́миже всѝ пое́мъ: ѻ҆́троцы бл҃гослови́те, сщ҃е́нницы пѣсносло́вите, лю́діе превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Angels glorify thy childbearing, O pure Bride of God; with them all we sing: Bless, O youths; hymn, O priests; supremely exalt Him, O people, unto all ages!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Methodius]:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ты̀ низложи́лъ є҆сѝ є҆рети́ческаѧ шата́ніѧ, є҆́же пои́стиннѣ ѕлочести́ваѧ, и҆ совозне́слъ є҆сѝ вѣ́рныхъ цр҃кве ѻ҆́ч҃е ро́гъ, хрⷭ҇то́вꙋ нака́зꙋѧ і҆кѡ́нꙋ честѝ Меѳо́діе. Тѣ́мже тѧ̀ пое́мъ и҆ любо́вію почита́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst cast down the haughty strivings of heretics, which were truly impious, and didst lift up the horn of the Church of the faithful, O Father, instructing that the icon of Christ be honored, O Methodius; therefore do we sing to thee and honor thee with love.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Methodius]:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Тѧ̀ ѕвѣздꙋ̀ всесвѣ́тлꙋю, сл҃нце показа̀ хрⷭ҇то́съ, на тве́рди премꙋ́дре цр҃ко́внѣй, и҆ твои́ми сіѧ́ніи чⷭ҇тныхъ ᲂу҆че́ній, концы̑ ѻ҆́ч҃е ѡ҆зари́лъ є҆сѝ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Christ the Sun showed thee forth as an all-radiant star upon the firmament of the Church, O most wise one; and by the beams of thy venerable teachings, O Father, thou hast enlightened the ends of the earth unto all ages.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Methodius]:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Твоѐ сло́во ꙗ҆́коже гро́мъ Меѳо́діе возшꙋмѣ̀ на землѝ, мамо́ны содѣ́йственника, и҆ роди́телѧ пре́лести, ꙗ҆́коже ѕмі́а свѧза́въ ѿсла́лъ є҆сѝ, тмѣ̀ вѣ́чнѣй, ꙗ҆́кѡ сꙋ́ща наслѣ́дника.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thy word resounded like thunder upon the earth, O Methodius; having bound the coworker of mammon and father of delusion like a serpent, thou didst banish him unto eternal darkness, as being its heir.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Є҆ди́нъ є҆сѝ є҆диноро́денъ горѣ̀, є҆ди́нъ и҆ до́лѣ то́йже, безъ мт҃ре горѣ̀ ѿ ѻ҆ц҃а̀, и҆ бе́зъ ѻ҆ц҃а̀ и҆зъ мт҃ре до́лꙋ: къ не́йже воѡбра́жсѧ въ чꙋ́ждее сло́ве ѡ҆бнища́въ, въ моѐ смири́вшеесѧ є҆стество̀ ѿ грѣха̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* Thou art the One Only-begotten on high, and the same One below: without a mother on high from the Father, and without a father from a mother below; taking form in her, having impoverished Thyself, O Word, into what was alien, into my nature humbled by sin.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, ѳ҃. І҆рмо́съ: Тѧ̀ па́че ᲂу҆ма̀ и҆ словесѐ мт҃рь бж҃ію, въ лѣ́то безлѣ́тнаго неизрече́ннѡ ро́ждшꙋю, вѣ́рніи є҆диномꙋ́дреннѡ велича́емъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Ode 9. Heirmos:* *Thee Who beyond mind and word art the Mother of God, Who in time ineffably gavest birth unto the Timeless One: we the faithful with one accord magnify!*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Да тѣ́лъ пока́жетъ воста́ніе, живонача́льникъ, возставлѧ́етъ мертвеца̀, ѻ҆́нюдъ не и҆мꙋ́ща дыха́ніѧ пло́тію: прⷪ҇ро́ка пока́зова пречⷭ҇тно́е.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* That the Author of life might show forth the resurrection of bodies, He raises a dead man who had no breath at all in the flesh, showing forth the prophet's most honorable [power].[^431]

items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ст҃и́телей красота̀, мона́хѡвъ ᲂу҆добре́ніе, всѣ́хъ вѣ́рныхъ ѡ҆́бразъ, цр҃кве па́стырь, и҆ правосла́вныхъ сте́пень, ты̀ є҆сѝ Меѳо́діе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* The beauty of hierarchs, the ornament of monastics, the pattern of all the faithful, the shepherd of the Church, and the bulwark of the Orthodox art thou, O Methodius.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ликꙋ́ѧ со а҆́гг҃лы пред̾ лице́мъ и҆зба́вителѧ, и҆ сла́вы є҆гѡ̀ наслажда́ѧсѧ, мл҃твами твои́ми на́съ ѿ всѧ́кихъ и҆скꙋше́ній и҆зба́ви Меѳо́діе.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Свѣти́ленъ. Подо́бенъ: Не́бо ѕвѣзда́ми: И҆ліинꙋ бл҃года́ть сꙋгꙋ́бꙋ прія́лъ є҆сѝ ѿ бг҃а, Е҆ліссе́е бг҃облаже́нне. И҆ просѧ́щымъ ᲂу҆ тебѐ вѣ́рнѡ, сꙋгꙋ́бѡ и҆сцѣле́ніѧ дае́ши, дꙋша́мъ же и҆ тѣ́лѡмъ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Another Heirmos [Canon of St. Methodius]:*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пріиди́те вѣ́рніи пое́мъ бж҃е́ственнꙋю па́мѧть, ст҃а́го дне́сь Меѳо́діа, въ ро́вѣ пречреподне́мъ вве́ржена. Да дꙋ́шы и҆зба́витъ погребе́нныѧ въ тмѣ̀, ѿ лꙋка́вагѡ нече́стіѧ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Come, ye faithful, let us sing of the divine memory of Saint Methodius today, who was cast into a nethermost pit,[^433] that he might deliver souls buried in darkness from evil impiety.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Препѣ́таѧ дв҃о и҆ бцⷣе, бг҃а неизрече́ннѡ ро́ждшаѧ, прилѣ́жнѡ молѝ сн҃а твоего̀, ѡ҆ на́съ рабѣ́хъ твои́хъ, ᲂу҆ще́дрити и҆ спастѝ, любо́вію хва́лѧщыѧ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: O all-hymned Virgin and Mother of God, who ineffably gavest birth unto God: earnestly entreat thy Son for us thy servants, to show compassion and save them that praise thee with love.

items.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF JUNE :: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *On the Aposticha, from the Octoechos.*
items.office: At Matins, one Canon of the Octoechos, and two of the saints, to 8
items.section: On the Aposticha, from the Octoechos.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Звѣзда̀ возсіѧ̀ бл҃гоче́стіѧ ѿ за́пада, сл҃нца ви́димагѡ, вели́кій во ст҃и́телехъ Меѳо́дій, и҆ мгрꙋ̀ пресѣ́клъ ѕлосла́вныхъ, почѝ на и҆́стиннемъ восто́цѣ, прⷵ҇внагѡ сл҃нца хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а на́шегѡ, и҆ та́мѡ со безпло́т- безпло́тными водворѧ́ѧсѧ ли́ки, и҆ прⷭ҇то́лꙋ предстоѧ̀ трⷪ҇ческому, ꙗ҆́кѡ прпⷣбенъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ мч҃нкъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ст҃ль, ꙗ҆́кѡ патрїа́рхъ, дѣѧ́ніемъ и҆ видѣ́ніемъ. На́мъ про́ситъ, вѣ́рою творѧ́щымъ сщ҃е́ннꙋю є҆гѡ̀ па́мѧть, ве́ліѧ ми́лости.
items.english_cohort_translation: A star of piety shone forth from the west of the visible sun: the great Methodius among hierarchs; and having cut through the mist of the ill-believing, he came to rest in the true East, of the spiritual Sun, Christ our God; and there with the bodiless taking up thy dwelling with the bodiless choirs, and standing before the Trinitarian throne, as a venerable one, as a martyr, as a hierarch, as a patriarch, by action and contemplation: ask great mercy for us who perform his holy memory in faith.
items.slavonic_text: Звѣзда̀ возсіѧ̀ бл҃гоче́стіѧ ѿ за́пада, сл҃нца ви́димагѡ, вели́кій во ст҃и́телехъ Меѳо́дій, и҆ мгрꙋ̀ пресѣ́клъ ѕлосла́вныхъ, почѝ на и҆́стиннемъ восто́цѣ, прⷵ҇внагѡ сл҃нца хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а на́шегѡ, и҆ та́мѡ со безпло́т- безпло́тными водворѧ́ѧсѧ ли́ки, и҆ прⷭ҇то́лꙋ предстоѧ̀ трⷪ҇ческому, ꙗ҆́кѡ прпⷣбенъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ мч҃нкъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ ст҃ль, ꙗ҆́кѡ патрїа́рхъ, дѣѧ́ніемъ и҆ видѣ́ніемъ. На́мъ про́ситъ, вѣ́рою творѧ́щымъ сщ҃е́ннꙋю є҆гѡ̀ па́мѧть, ве́ліѧ ми́лости.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: Подо́бенъ: Трїдне́венъ: Зача́тіе твоѐ безсѣ́менное, и҆ ржⷭ҇тво̀ несказа́нное, помышля́ющи дивлю́ся ѕѣлѡ̀; ка́кѡ сн҃це ꙗ҆́коже ѕлодѣ́й, бл҃говоли́лъ єсѝ оу҆мре́ти сн҃е, пречи́стаѧ взыва́ше.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion. Podoben: "Having risen on the third day" (Трїдне́венъ):* Contemplating thy seedless conception and ineffable childbearing, I marvel greatly: How, O my Sun, hast Thou deigned to die as an evildoer, O my Son? the All-pure one cried out.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ѡ҆брѣ́те дꙋхо́внаѧ зарѧ̀ твоегѡ̀ оу҆ма̀ прⷪ҇ро́че чистотꙋ̀, сіѧ́ющꙋ ꙗ҆́коже зерца́ло ꙗ҆́вственнѡ, и҆ мі́ръ ѡ҆зарѝ, бг҃оразꙋ́міѧ сіѧ́ніемъ блиста́ющꙋ, и҆ прошобража́ющꙋ бж҃твенныхъ та́инъ ѡ҆́бразы: бл҃года́ть же всѣ̑мъ чл҃вѣ́кѡмъ хотѧ́щꙋ пода́тисѧ пречꙋ́дне.
items.english_cohort_translation: The spiritual dawn found the purity of thy mind, O prophet, shining clearly like a mirror, and enlightened the world, flashing with the radiance of divine knowledge, and prefiguring the images of divine mysteries: grace being about to be bestowed upon all men, O most marvelous one!

items.verbatim_book_heading: MONTH OF JUNE :: At the Liturgy
items.verbatim_section_rubric: *At the Liturgy:*
items.office: At the Liturgy
items.section: On the Aposticha, from the Octoechos.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆ста̀ бы́въ бж҃іа, нече́стіа дѣ́латели ꙗ҆́вѣ ѡ҆бличи́лъ єсѝ, сꙋдо́мъ неизбѣ́жнымъ, ты́ѧ ѡ҆сꙋди́въ пребога́те, пе́рвымъ оу҆че́ніемъ послѣ́дꙋѧ, и҆ бж҃е́ственнымъ сꙋдо́мъ. Тѣ́мже премꙋ́дрымъ твои́мъ гла́сѡмъ, ви́дѧще возведе́ніе блаже́нне, пѣ́снми досто́йнѡ восхваля́емъ тѧ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having become the mouth of God, thou didst openly rebuke the workers of impiety; with an inescapable judgment thou didst condemn them, O most rich one, following the former teachings and the divine judgments; therefore, seeing the elevation of thy most wise voices, O blessed one, we worthily praise thee in hymns.

items.section: On the Aposticha, from the Octoechos.
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Прⷭ҇то́лꙋ бл҃чню предстоѧ̀, и҆ неизрече́нныѧ и҆ бж҃твенныѧ сла́вы насыща́емь, добро́ты же зрѧ̀ премі́рныѧ, и҆ свѣ́та наполня́емь, а҆ммѡ́се бг҃оглаго́ливе, всѧ̑ чтꙋ́щыѧ тѧ̀ вѣ́рою помина́й, си̑мъ дꙋше́вное сп҃ніе, разрѣше́ніѧ же согрѣше́ній, всѣ̑мъ просѧ̀ бг҃опрїѧ́тне.
items.english_cohort_translation: Standing before the Master's throne, and being filled with ineffable and divine glory, beholding supermundane beauties, and being filled with light, O Amos, speaker of God: be mindful of all them that honor thee with faith, asking for them the salvation of the soul and the remission of transgressions, O God-pleasing one!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ра́дꙋйсѧ сл҃нцезра́чнаѧ ѕвѣздо̀, ра́дꙋйсѧ вино́внаѧ всѣ́хъ до́брыхъ пренепоро́чнаѧ, ра́дꙋйсѧ ра́дꙋйсѧ вмѣсти́вшаѧ бг҃а невмѣсти́маго, ꙗ҆́же кла́съ прозѧ́бшаѧ безсме́ртїа. Ра́дꙋйсѧ бж҃е́ственное носи́ло, и҆ две́ре всесвѣ́тлаѧ. Ра́дꙋйсѧ клѧ́твы оу҆бїе́ніе, прароди́тельныѧ на́шеѧ ѻ҆трокови́це, бл҃ги́хъ хода́таица сꙋ́щи.
items.english_cohort_translation: Rejoice, O star bright as the sun! Rejoice, O cause of all good things, all-immaculate one! Rejoice rejoice, thou that didst contain the uncontainable God, who didst bud forth the Ear of Immortality! Rejoice, divine conveyance, and all-radiant gate! Rejoice, slaying of the ancestral curse, O maiden, being the mediatress of good things!

items.section: Other Stichera of the Mother of God, Tone 2. Podoben: The same [When from the Tree] (Подо́бенъ то́йже)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Всѣ́хъ скорбѧ́щихъ ра́досте, и҆ ѡ҆би́димыхъ предста́тельнице, и҆ оу҆бо́гихъ пита́тельнице, стра́нныхъ же оу҆тѣше́ніе, и҆ же́зле слѣпы́хъ, немощны́хъ посѣще́ніе, трꙋжда́ющихсѧ покро́ве и҆ застꙋ́пнице, и҆ си́рыхъ помо́щнице, мт҃и бг҃а вы́шнагѡ, ты̀ є҆сѝ пречⷭ҇таѧ: потщи́ся, мо́лимся, спасти́ся рабѡ́мъ твои́мъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: Joy of all that sorrow, and protectress of the wronged, and nourisher of the poor, consolation of strangers, and staff of the blind, visitation of the sick, shelter and protectress of them that labor, and helper of orphans, Mother of God Most High, art thou, O All-pure one: hasten, we pray, to save thy servants![^440]

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Other Stichera of the Mother of God, Tone 2. Podoben: The same [When from the Tree] (Подо́бенъ то́йже):*
items.office: At the Liturgy
items.section: Other Stichera of the Mother of God, Tone 2. Podoben: The same [When from the Tree] (Подо́бенъ то́йже)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Покро́въ и҆ застꙋпле́ніе, на́мъ хрⷭ҇тїа́нѡмъ ты̀ є҆сѝ, и҆ прибѣ́жище держа́вно мт҃и бг҃а вы́шнагѡ, но и҆ ны́нѣ ꙗ҆́кѡ при́снѡ, бо́дренною твое́ю моли́твою, не преста́й моля́щи сп҃тѝ рабы̑ твоѧ̑ ѡ҆тъ ѡ҆бстоѧ́ній всѣ́хъ, ꙗ҆́кѡ тѧ̀ съ бг҃омъ и҆́мамы застꙋпле́ніе всѝ хрⷭ҇тїа́не и҆ прибѣ́жище.
items.english_cohort_translation: Thou art a shelter and protection for us Christians, and a mighty refuge, O Mother of God Most High; but now as ever, by thy vigilant prayer, cease not to pray that thy servants may be saved from all tribulations; for after God, all we Christians have thee as protection and refuge!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆на́гѡ держа́внагѡ прибѣ́жища, и҆ крѣ́пости столпа̀, и҆ стѣны̀ неѡбори́мыѧ, вои́стиннꙋ не стѧжа́хомъ, ра́звѣ тебѐ пречⷭ҇таѧ. Къ тебѣ̀ прибѣга́емъ, и҆ тебѣ̀ вопіе́мъ: влⷣчце помозѝ да не поги́бнемъ, покажѝ твою̀ бл҃года́ть на на́съ, и҆ крѣ́пости сла́вꙋ, и҆ милосе́рдіа твоегѡ̀ вели́чество. Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ:
items.english_cohort_translation: Truly we possess no other mighty refuge, or tower of strength, or insurmountable wall, save thee, O All-pure one! Unto thee do we flee, and unto thee do we cry: O Lady, help, lest we perish; show forth thy grace upon us, and the glory of thy strength, and the greatness of thy tender mercy!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Є҆гда̀ нескве́рнаѧ а҆́гница, ви́дѣ своего̀ а҆́гнца, на заколе́ніе ꙗ҆́кѡ чл҃вѣ́ка во́лею вле́кома, пла́чꙋщи глаго́лаше: безча́дствовати мѧ̀ ны́нѣ тщи́шися хрⷭ҇тѐ ро́ждшꙋю тѧ̀. Что̀ сіѐ сотвори́лъ єсѝ, и҆зба́вителю всѧ́ческихъ? Ѻ҆ба́че воспѣва́ю и҆ сла́влю, твою̀ ю҆́же па́че оу҆ма̀ и҆ сло́ва, кра́йнюю бл҃го́сть человѣколю́бче.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion:* When the undefiled Ewe-lamb saw her Lamb willingly dragged unto slaughter as a man,[^441] weeping she said: Dost Thou hasten now to make me childless, O Christ, who gave Thee birth? What is this that Thou hast done, O Redeemer of all? Yet I hymn and glorify Thine extreme goodness that is beyond mind and word, O Lover of mankind!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Оу҆тверди́хся и҆сповѣ́давъ бж҃твенное твоѐ рождество̀, и҆ предста́тельницꙋ тѧ̀ дв҃о бога́тѣ зовꙋ̀: ра́дꙋйсѧ бг҃оневѣ́стнаѧ наде́ждо моѧ̀ и҆ по́моще.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Theotokion:* I was established, having confessed thy divine childbearing, and I richly call thee protectress, O Virgin: Rejoice, O Bride of God, my hope and help!

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 3:* *Podoben: "Of divine faith" (Бж҃твенныѧ вѣ́ры):*
items.office: At the Liturgy
items.section: Sessional Hymn, Tone 3:* *Podoben: "Of divine faith" (Бж҃твенныѧ вѣ́ры)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Сѣда́ленъ, гла́съ, г҃. Подо́бенъ: Бж҃твенныѧ вѣ́ры: Бж҃твенный ѻ҆рга́нъ оу҆тѣ́шителевъ, подгла́шаемь сегѡ̀ бл҃же́нне бл҃гтію всегда̀ ꙗ҆́снѡ, прⷪ҇ро́къ бы́лъ єсѝ. Возглаша́еши бо безвѣ́стныхъ ꙗ҆вле́ніе, и҆ ѡ҆зарѧ́еши вѣ́рою притека́ющыѧ, а҆ммѡ́се сла́вне, хрⷭ҇та̀ бг҃а молѝ, дарова́ти на́мъ ве́лію ми́лость.
items.english_cohort_translation: A divine instrument of the Comforter, attuned by His grace ever clearly, O blessed one, wast thou as a prophet; for thou proclaimest the manifestation of unknown things, and dost enlighten them that flee with faith, O glorious Amos: entreat Christ God to grant us great mercy!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бж҃е́ственнагѡ є҆стества̀ не ѿлꙋчи́вся, пло́ть бы́въ во чре́вѣ твое́мъ: но бг҃ъ вочеловѣ́чися и҆ пребы́сть, и҆́же по ржⷭ҇твѣ̀ мт҃рь тѧ̀ дв҃ꙋ, ꙗ҆́кѡ пре́жде ржⷭ҇тва̀ сохрани́въ всенепоро́чнꙋ, є҆ди́нъ гдⷭ҇ь: того̀ прилѣ́жнѡ молѝ, дарова́ти на́мъ ве́лію млⷭ҇ть.
items.english_cohort_translation: Not parting from the divine nature when He became flesh in thy womb, but God became man and remained [God], Who after childbirth preserved thee a Virgin Mother all-immaculate, even as before childbirth, the One Lord: Him earnestly entreat to grant us great mercy!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Крⷭ҇тобг҃оро́диченъ: Нескве́рнаѧ а҆́гница сло́ва, нетлѣ́ннаѧ дв҃а мт҃и, на крⷭ҇тѣ̀ зрѧ́щи повѣ́шена, и҆з̾ неѧ̀ безъ болѣ́зни прозѧ́бшаго, мт҃рски подо́бнѡ рыда́ющи, вопіѧ́ше: оу҆вы́ мнѣ̀ ча́до моѐ, ка́кѡ стра́ждеши во́лею? хотя̀ и҆зба́вити ѿ страсте́й безче́стіа человѣ́ка.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Stavrotheotokion:* The undefiled Ewe-lamb of the Word, the incorrupt Virgin Mother, seeing Him Who sprouted from her without travail hanging upon the Cross, maternally wailing, cried out: Woe is me, my Child! How sufferest Thou willingly, desiring to deliver man from the passions of dishonor?

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Проро́ка тѧ̀ и҆́же пе́рвѣе па́стырѧ показа̀ бг҃ъ, воспріе́мъ сщ҃енноꙗвле́нне а҆ммѡ́се. Тѣ́мъ тѧ̀ всѝ вѣ́рою оу҆блажа́емъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, є҃. І҆рмо́съ: Къ тебѣ̀ оу҆́тренюю, и҆ тебѣ̀ вопію̀ бл҃гоꙋтро́бне гдⷭ҇и: ѡ҆мраче́ннꙋю грѣхмѝ дꙋ́шꙋ мою̀, свѣ́томъ ѡ҆зари́въ за́повѣдей твои́хъ наста́ви.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 3:* *Podoben: "Of divine faith" (Бж҃твенныѧ вѣ́ры):*
items.office: At the Liturgy
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆мерщвле́нныхъ снѣ́дною стрѣло́ю, бл҃же́нне оу҆кори́лъ єсѝ, ꙗ҆́кѡ непщꙋ́ющымъ впа́днꙋти внꙋ́треннимъ, и҆ прело́жно бы́ти, и҆ тлѣ́нно наслажде́ніе.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst rebuke them that were slain by the arrow of food, O blessed one,[^449] since their inner parts were about to fall into thoughtlessness, and their pleasure was fleeting and corrupt.

items.office: At the Liturgy
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бога́тыми свѣтоли́тіи ѡ҆сіѧ́емь, ꙗ҆ви́лся єсѝ бг҃оглаго́ливъ, и҆ собесѣ́дникъ бж҃ій, возвѣща́ѧ всѣ̑мъ бл҃гоче́стіа и҆́стинный пꙋ́ть.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Sessional Hymn, Tone 3:* *Podoben: "Of divine faith" (Бж҃твенныѧ вѣ́ры):*
items.office: At the Liturgy
items.slavonic_diplomatic: И҆зба́вити всѧ̑, тѧ̀ пою́щыѧ бл҃же́нне молѝ, ѿ лишє́ній и҆ сѣте́й вра́жіихъ; и҆ свѣ́томъ ѡ҆сіѧ́ти нбⷭ҇нымъ, црⷭ҇тва хрⷭ҇то́ва.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Entreat, O blessed one, to deliver all them that hymn thee from deprivations and the snares of the enemy; and that they may be illumined with the heavenly light of Christ's Kingdom!

items.office: At the Liturgy
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Пречⷭ҇тагѡ твоегѡ̀ дѣ́вства пою̀ дв҃о неска́занное, и҆ чⷭ҇тно́е ржⷭ҇тво̀, и҆ сла́влю пречⷭ҇таѧ, и҆́миже спасо́хомся тлѝ и҆ сме́рти.

items.section: Kontakion, Tone 2:* *Tone 2, Podoben: "Thou hast appeared today" (Ꙗ҆ви́лся єсѝ дне́сь)
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Конда́къ, гла́съ, в҃: Подо́бенъ: Ꙗ҆ви́лся єсѝ дне́сь: Ѡ҆чи́стивъ дх҃омъ проро́че твоѐ свѣтоза́рное срⷣце сла́вный а҆ммѡ́се, прⷪ҇ро́чествіѧ да́ръ свы́ше пріе́мъ, возопи́лъ єсѝ велегла́снѡ во страна́хъ: сѐ бг҃ъ на́шъ, и҆ не приложи́тсѧ и҆́нъ къ немꙋ̀.
items.english_cohort_translation: Having purified thy radiant heart by the Spirit, O glorious prophet Amos, having received the gift of prophecy from on high, thou didst cry aloud with a great voice in the lands: Lo, this is our God, and none other shall be compared unto Him![^452]

items.office: At the Liturgy
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Пѣ́снь, з҃. І҆рмо́съ: Въ пе́щь ѻ҆́гненнꙋю вве́ржени прпⷣбніи ѻ҆́троцы, ѻ҆́гнь въ ро́сꙋ преложи́ша, воспѣва́ніемъ си́це вопію́ще: бл҃гослове́нъ єсѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.

items.verbatim_section_rubric: *Kontakion, Tone 2:* *Tone 2, Podoben: "Thou hast appeared today" (Ꙗ҆ви́лся єсѝ дне́сь):*
items.office: At the Liturgy
items.slavonic_diplomatic: Є҆́же предглаго́лалъ єсѝ, бж҃е́ственное спасе́ніе ꙗ҆ви́ся, а҆ммѡ́се проро́че чꙋ́дне, просвѣще́ніи бл҃гоче́стіа ѡ҆сія́въ мі́ръ, вопіѧ́лъ єсѝ: бл҃гослове́нъ єсѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* That which thou didst foretell, the divine salvation, was made manifest, O marvelous prophet Amos; having enlightened the world with the illuminations of piety, thou didst cry: Blessed art Thou, O Lord God of our fathers!

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Храня́емь бж҃е́ственною си́лою, бг҃опроти́вными врагѝ неврежде́нъ бы́лъ єсѝ, терпѣли́внѡ ꙗ҆́коже а҆дама́нтъ пребы́лъ єсѝ зовы́й: бл҃гослове́нъ єсѝ гдⷭ҇и гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Preserved by divine power, thou wast unharmed by the God-opposing foes; enduringly didst thou abide like adamant, crying: Blessed art Thou, O Lord *...God of our fathers!*

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Бг҃оро́диченъ: Непостижи́мое ржⷭ҇тво̀ дв҃ы славосло́вимъ, и҆́мже сме́рти и҆зба́вихомся. Є҆гѡ́же ра́ди ро́ждшеся въ нетлѣ́ніе, зове́: бл҃гослове́нъ єсѝ гдⷭ҇и бж҃е ѻ҆ц҃ъ на́шихъ.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Ве́сь восте́клъ єсѝ на го́рнюю высотꙋ̀, и҆ навы́клъ єсѝ неизрече́нныхъ ра́зꙋмъ, и҆ бы́лъ єсѝ сказа́тель сло́ва воплоще́ніа а҆ммѡ́се: тѣ́мже тѧ̀ воспѣва́емъ во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* Thou didst ascend wholly unto the heavenly heights, and didst learn the understanding of ineffable things, and becamest a proclaimer of the incarnation of the Word, O Amos; therefore do we hymn thee unto all ages.

items.slavonic_diplomatic: Оу҆ма̀ ѻ҆строто́ю всѣ́хъ вл҃кꙋ разꙋмѣ́ти, ꙗ҆́коже є҆́сть мо́щно сподо́бился єсѝ, ꙗ҆влѧ́юща тѧ̀ неизрече́нныхъ ра́зꙋмꙋ, зовы́й: сщ҃е́нницы по́йте, лю́діе превозноси́те во всѧ̑ вѣ́ки.
items.english_cohort_translation: *Troparion:* By the sharpness of thy mind, as much as is possible, thou wast accounted worthy to understand the Master of all, Who revealed thee unto the understanding of ineffable things, crying: Praise, ye priests; O people, supremely exalt Him unto all ages!
